This inability to maintain profitability is further underscored by a dismal return on equity of 0.28%, which significantly trails the sector benchmark of 4.11% [E5]. Despite these relative metrics, the lack of any dividend yield confirms that the business is failing to return value to shareholders [E3]. Investors should view the current market capitalisation of ₹ 12.1 Cr with extreme caution given the underlying erosion of the company's equity base [E2].
